hotels.title: Sunshine Coast Hilltop One-, Two- & Three-Bedroom Villas near Coolum Beach
hotels.description: Experience the tranquillity of the Sunshine Coast with a stay at this elevated, oceanfront haven between Coolum's pristine beaches, ultra-cool cafes and the spectacular Mount Coolum National Park. This stylish retreat provides direct access to the secluded Third Bay beachfront and connects you to the region’s best attractions, including the vibrant Eumundi Markets, Noosa’s Hastings Street and the cafes of Maroochydore. Hike through the lush hinterland or watch a spectacular sunrise over the spectacular coastline. After a day of exploring, retreat to your private balcony or terrace to soak up panoramic views of the ocean, prepare a meal in your fully equipped kitchen or take a dip in one of the two onsite swimming pools. For a unique dining experience, visit the nearby BASK Restaurant, recognised for its excellence with two Australian Good Food Guide Chef Hats.
